fields.subject: Mapper.HasCollectionMapProperties
fields.trigger: a caller asks whether a model type declares any CollectionMapAttributeBase-decorated property
fields.response: the Mapper shall report true when the model type has at least one property decorated with a CollectionMapAttributeBase-derived attribute whose property type is a recognized collection type, shall report false when the model type has no such decorated property, and shall throw InvalidOperationException instead of returning a value when a decorated property's type is not a recognized collection type
